text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(x, y) ::: x was the location of the last Olympic games.
MostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is the Olympic games.
WorldChampionships(x) ::: x is the world championships.

Premises:
SportingEvent(olympicGames) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(olympicGames, tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
MostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.

Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
